verdict.rationale: Drive documents folder sharing with inherited access, view-only ('only open') roles, and link sharing with 'anyone', which covers organized shared folders and view-only links. Access visibility is only available through the permissions API or a build-your-own sharing-audit spreadsheet, not a built-in data-room view, and download controls are not evidenced at all. missing for 10: download/print/copy restriction controls, built-in viewer activity or access analytics for diligence, independent or hands-on corroboration of data-room use.
